pairs.evidence: app/features/tools/devcases/useDevTabNeedAnalysis.ts:108 This context only renders evaluation results and sends typed JSON (need, analysis, role, case) to server routes. Any prompt is built server-side, outside this context. A case-insensitive search of app/features/tools/devcases and app/features/tools/interview for systemPrompt, max_tokens, anthropic, compaction and tokenBudget found nothing. 'prompt' does appear, but only as the displayed candidate-assistant prompt-signal metrics (DevEvalPanelChecks promptSignals), not as assembly.

pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/setup/setupSteps.ts:4 The wizard is a step model plus UI copy taken from i18n catalogs. A search of app/features/shell/setup for systemPrompt, max_tokens, anthropic, compaction and tokenBudget found nothing, and 'llm' found nothing either.
